content.passage: My friend Sara is one of the most thoughtful people I know. She loves helping others and often spends her weekends volunteering at different places. Sara is also very friendly and enjoys making new friends. In her free time, she loves to read books, especially mysteries. Every Saturday, we play basketball together. Sara is also responsible and always helps her family at home. Sara was in a car accident and now she can't walk. She uses a wheelchair, but it doesn't stop her from having fun. She's interested in everything and she often wants to try new things.
